scope: Source-sized representative hotel lobby/guest/gym, library reading floor and office work floor. Production E/admin mode, physical moving leaf, actual closed/open ray collision, capsule blocked-close, walk-through/inside-egress and pause; role parts and small standing capsules are independently observed. Role captures independently check actual head/prop projection, static LOS, original-avatar/HUD exclusion and a grounded player stance before a native forced frame. Scenario starts are labelled, movement contains no per-step teleports and no NPC/avatar model is relocated for a screenshot. Guest doors enclose authored game rooms only; exterior private/source bodies are unchanged. No surveyed occupancy, full catalog role audit, human usability or performance acceptance.
